subject.title: Dashboard: widget write-back — persist widget state via a setState bridge capability

question: Should dashboard widget write-back be accepted only after a SQLite/plugin-KV storage redesign, or may this PR land with an explicit JSON-state and sandbox write-back exception?
rationale: The PR changes persistent runtime storage and the iframe-to-parent trust boundary, which automation cannot safely approve without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Require storage redesign before merge
options.body: Keep the feature direction open but require widget state to use plugin KV/shared SQLite, plus fresh live proof and security review after #101098 lands.

options.title: Approve an explicit exception
options.body: A maintainer/security owner can intentionally accept the per-widget JSON state path and current bridge contract as product debt before code review continues.

options.title: Pause behind the stack
options.body: Pause this PR until the custom-widget host stack lands or is rejected, avoiding review of a write-back layer on an unsettled foundation.

recommendation.title: Require storage redesign before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction open but require widget state to use plugin KV/shared SQLite, plus fresh live proof and security review after #101098 lands.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest visible product-routing owner signal for the Control UI plugin-tab surface this dashboard stack extends.
